findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "optimize" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_problem, explain_solution · Public sink: pack_bins.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_problem, explain_solution · Public sink: pack_bins

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
